name: cuda-hip-rocm
description: Selectable kernel translation work orders with evidence-bounded CUDA-to-HIP/ROC execution.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, select, translate, compile, and validate source-kernel rewrites.
interface.longDescription: Defines strict semantic work orders, selectable publisher and runtime profiles, deterministic safe and leap-target trajectories, and an evidence-bounded CUDA-to-HIP implementation backed by the generated HIPIFY API mapping catalog. Translation, compilation, AMD execution, reference parity, and profiling remain distinct evidence classes.
defaultPrompt: Inventory this CUDA project and show the HIP/ROCm porting holds.
Port these CUDA kernels to a separate HIP C++ tree and run the real compile and AMD parity witness.
Create a kernel work order, select the Strix Halo runtime profile, and plan the safe path before optimizing.
